raw.query: WITH model_wape AS (SELECT variate, mode, resolution, model, SUM(ABS(y_true - point)) / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(y_true)), 0) AS wape FROM v_forecast_thesis_corpus WHERE ABS(y_true)>0 GROUP BY variate, mode, resolution, model), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY variate, mode, resolution ORDER BY wape) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY variate, mode, resolution) n FROM model_wape) SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE margin<0.02) n_under_2wapepts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE margin<=0.001) n_under_0_1wapept, ROUND(MIN(margin)::numeric,5) min_margin, ROUND(MAX(margin)::numeric,5) max_margin, ROUND(AVG(margin)::numeric,5) avg_margin FROM (SELECT variate, mode, resolution, (MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) - MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE rn=1)) margin FROM ranked WHERE n>=2 GROUP BY variate, mode, resolution, n) g
